**Finding: deviation (high severity) — § 12.4**

§ 12.4 imposes on us a non-compete running for the term plus twenty-four months, covering "any product or service that competes with Vendor in any territory," and extending to acquisitions. This is walk-away territory under NONCOMPETE (post-term restriction over 12 months, undefined scope, no territorial limit) and fails the fallback on every material term. It also flatly contradicts § 12.3, where Vendor acknowledges that we have made no non-compete or exclusivity commitment.

Redline (validated, preferred position): delete § 12.4 in full, with the narrowed fallback (single named product, term only, ≤12 months, carve-outs for internal development and acquisitions) offered in the comment as a negotiating position.
